_about: John Francis Campbell of Islay's (1822-1885) Popular Tales of the West Highlands, orally collected, with his translations (new edition, Paisley: Alexander Gardner, 1890, 4 vols). Raw Internet Archive OCR; the Gaelic originals stand beside his English. Campbell is collector and translator. US public domain. Added at the coordinator's standing relay (2026-10-02: choose public-domain storytellers batches; Adam may veto).
